planned_only.name: VFD spindle control planned
planned_only.source_line: LinuxCNC Forum member RotarySMP describes rebuilding a specific 7×12 mini-lathe and preparing it for LinuxCNC. The machine had previously run TurboCNC with a once-per-revolution spindle encoder, but the owner noted that its X-axis ballscrew had never been installed. After the plastic back gears broke and its DC motor failed, the spindle was changed to a three-phase 3/4 hp induction motor and VFD with a toothed-belt drive. The owner also undertook scraping and geometry correction of the bed and tailstock surfaces.
